title:
Rates are rising.
Should you *wait?*
source: URA flash estimate Q3 2026 · illustration: 30 yr loan at ~2.5%
caption:
Rates are rising again, and some buyers are pausing. ⏳

But prices didn't pause. Last quarter they still rose 1.4%. On a $2M home that's $28,000 more. A 0.25% rate rise on a $1.5M loan adds about $200 a month. That $28K is over 11 years of the extra interest.

On a floating or fixed loan right now? Comment FLOAT or FIXED 👇
